judge_comment: FAIL ['C3']: The mitigants list includes 'Full KYC completed and audited accounts supplied', which is a non‑genuine mitigant per policy, causing failure of criterion C3.

FAIL ['C2', 'C5']: The assessment states six years of trading history as a mitigant, which contradicts the registry check (R10) showing only 1.5 years of trading; this violates grounding (C2) and the case‑specific rule prohibiting citing six years of trading (C5).
